_comment: Check table for disclosure_scan.py. Keys are register IDs from references/standards.md, so the scanner and the findings share one namespace. Adding a check should never require touching Python. Patterns are Python re, case-insensitive by default.

checks.hint: A registered entity name plus suffix (e.g. 'Something Health, Inc.'), not the bare word 'incorporated'. Template placeholders are excluded automatically, so a hit here means a real entity name is published somewhere - read the context to confirm it is WellPeps' own and appears in Terms, Privacy, NPP and the footer.
A street address anywhere on the site. Zero hits means Standard 1 is unmet. Regulator addresses (HHS OCR in the NPP) are excluded - they are not the merchant's address.
checks.exclude: Office for Civil Rights|Independence Avenue|Washington, D\.C\.|HHS

checks.hint: Every blanket licensure claim. Each hit must be backed by the licensure matrix or removed.
Tier 3 peptides per COMPLIANCE-CHEAT-SHEET.md s1. Any hit presented as a therapy or benefit is S1.
Every place the site refers to a pharmacy generically. Each is a slot where the named pharmacy belongs.
The MSO role disclaimer. Verify it survives any footer rewrite.

checks.pattern: \b(Alabama|Alaska|Arizona|Arkansas|California|Colorado|Connecticut|Delaware|Florida|Georgia|Hawaii|Idaho|Illinois|Indiana|Iowa|Kansas|Kentucky|Louisiana|Maine|Maryland|Massachusetts|Michigan|Minnesota|Mississippi|Missouri|Montana|Nebraska|Nevada|New Hampshire|New Jersey|New Mexico|New York|North Carolina|North Dakota|Ohio|Oklahoma|Oregon|Pennsylvania|Rhode Island|South Carolina|South Dakota|Tennessee|Texas|Utah|Vermont|Virginia|Washington|West Virginia|Wisconsin|Wyoming)\b
checks.hint: An actually enumerated state list: at least 10 distinct state names must appear. Prose saying 'all 50 states' does not satisfy Standard 5, and a single incidental mention (a state of incorporation, a privacy-law reference) must not pass it.
Draft banner and internal workflow placeholders. Verified rendering in production 2026-09-22. Highest single application risk.
Read each hit: a real date, or a placeholder?
Without absolute_redirect off, nginx builds redirects from its own listen 80 scheme and downgrades HTTPS to HTTP. Confirmed live 2026-09-22.

checks.pattern: needs to\s+build|must still be built|still (has|needs) to be built|not yet wired|doesn't do anything|does not do anything|build the working opt-out
checks.hint: Unbuilt privacy controls the page nonetheless promises. Calibrated against the real wording in your-privacy-choices.astro.

LegitScript names missing prescription-required language as the most common application-delaying gap. Checked in the BUILT program pages (needs a fresh build): the line is rendered by the shared product-card disclosures (src/data/product-disclosures.ts), so it cannot be found in the per-program data files.
Placeholder navigation links. Expect 5 in Footer.astro.
The structure/function statement specified in COMPLIANCE-CHEAT-SHEET.md:264 and :197.
Check coverage across all four programs, not just where it already appears.
Records the current value. A reviewer seeing Opening Soon everywhere cannot evaluate the prescription flow.
Pre-certification: nothing in the BUILT output may claim or imply certification. Source comments are fine; rendered HTML is not.

live._comment: Routes checked by the --live pass. Each is fetched without a trailing slash to expose redirect behaviour.
